verdict.rationale: Mercury ships an official MCP server allowing natural-language queries ('What's my balance today?', 'Graph my last 6 months of transactions') plus a documented CLI with agent skills for natural-language-driven financial operations, corroborated by first-party docs and a probe confirming the MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user testimony specifically about using natural-language commands (community evidence covers general product satisfaction, not NL command usage) and detail on the breadth/accuracy of NL command coverage beyond the two example queries.
